semiconductor_relevance: High — CKD Corporation specializes in automation and fluid control technologies essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: CKD Corporation develops and manufactures automation machinery and fluid control components that are critical in semiconductor production. With over 80 years of experience, they provide solutions for both front-end and back-end processes, ensuring high precision and stability in manufacturing.
capabilities: Wet fine systems for super-clean control of chemical liquids
Dry fine systems for ultra-precise gas control
High-vacuum control equipment for exhaust and pressure management
